# Conversation starters

Questions, polls and prompts that get people to reply.

11 templates. Square brackets are placeholders: replace every one before you post.

## Question for your audience (`question`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Start a conversation and hear what people think.

```text
We would love your view: [your question]?

A) [first option]
B) [second option]

Reply with A or B, or tell us what we missed. We read every answer.
```

## Ask a question (`liQuestion`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Simple, as long as you ask something people want to answer.

```text
[audience]: what is one [tool, habit or idea] you could not work without?

Mine: [your answer].
```

## Ask for hot takes (`liOpinionPrompt`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Invite others to share their unpopular opinions, and go first.

```text
What is an unpopular opinion you hold about [topic]?

I will go first: [your take].
```

## A poll (`liPoll`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Polls make it easy to take part. Use them now and then, not every week.

```text
What matters more for [audience or stage]?

• [option A]
• [option B]

Vote, then tell me why in the comments.
```

## What would you do? (`liScenario`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Share a real dilemma and let people weigh in.

```text
Scenario: [the situation you faced].

What would you do?

I will share what we did in the comments tomorrow.
```

## Say thank you (`liThanks`)

- Network: LinkedIn
- Use it when: Thank someone who helped. They reply, and their network sees it.

```text
A thank you to [person] for [what they did].

It helped more than they know: [the difference it made].
```

## Quick vote (`xPoll`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: Easy to join, and you learn what your audience thinks.

```text
Quick question for [audience]:

[your question]

A) [option]
B) [option]
C) [option]

Reply with a letter.
```

## Describe it in one word (`xOneWord`)

- Network: X
- Use it when: An easy ask that gets a lot of replies. Good for reach, less so for authority.

```text
Describe [thing] in one word.

I will start: [your word].
```

## Best examples, add yours (`hExamples`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Share your favourites and ask people to add more.

```text
The best examples of [topic] I have seen:

• [example]
• [example]
• [example]

What would you add?
```

## Questions that are hard to answer (`hHardQuestions`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Ask the questions your audience struggles with.

```text
[number] questions every [role] struggles to answer:

1. [question]
2. [question]
3. [question]

Which one is hardest for you?
```

## Which problem is yours? (`hFourProblems`)

- Network: any network
- Use it when: Sort your audience's problems so each person finds theirs.

```text
Most [audience] struggle with one of these:

1. They do not [problem]
2. They do not [problem]
3. They cannot [problem]
4. They have no [problem]

Which one is yours?
```
